title: This Spacecraft Came Back From Death 20 Years Later

author: Scott Manley
description:
Since it's Halloween - here's a story of spacecraft that returned from the grave, spacecraft which died and were abandoned and then somehow, returned from the dead. Well there's also a story about a hacker bringing a spacecraft back to life, with the help of a 'Frankenstein' satellite model assembled after a grave robbing incident.
